sections.description: The core bridge between Exacoat Manager ERP, WooCommerce orders, custom status, and fulfillment tracking.
sections.changelog:
### Version 0.0.53
- Added transactional mail provider readiness checks (ZeptoMail / SMTP) to prevent false positive email sent status
- Added direct ZeptoMail API integration with attachments
- Added clear/reset JNE export email sent log endpoint and UI button
- Added active mail service warning when ZeptoMail is disabled
